description: This file defines the NoteShareActivity class, which handles sharing notes within the Android app. It manages user interactions, search functionality, contact selection, share creation, permission management, and UI updates related to sharing features.

classes.name: NoteShareActivity
classes.description: Main activity class managing note sharing functionalities, including user interface interactions, search, contact handling, share creation and updates, permission controls, and UI theming.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes activity, sets up UI, registers activity result launchers, and starts argument initialization in background.

methods.name: registerResultLauncher
methods.description: Registers launcher to handle activity results, specifically for re-creating activity after some actions.

methods.name: initializeOnBackPressedDispatcher
methods.description: Sets up custom back press behavior to navigate to MainActivity.

methods.name: initializeArguments
methods.description: Extracts note and account objects from intent extras, sets up repository and capabilities, and initializes sharing UI components.

methods.name: onStart
methods.description: Sets search configuration to allow user searches pending activity start.

methods.name: onStop
methods.description: Resets search-related configs when activity stops.

methods.name: disableSearchView
methods.description: Recursively disables a view and its children to prevent user input.

methods.name: setupReadOnlySearchView
methods.description: Configures the search view for read-only mode with appropriate hints and disables input.

methods.name: setupSearchView
methods.description: Configures search view functionality, including suggestions adapter, text listeners, and search behavior with delay and threading.

methods.name: navigateNoteShareDetail
methods.description: Launches NoteShareDetailActivity with note and sharee info based on search suggestion click.

methods.name: accountOwnsFile
methods.description: Determines if current account is the owner of the note based on shares.

methods.name: setShareWithYou
methods.description: Displays shared owner info if note is shared with someone else.

methods.name: copyInternalLink
methods.description: Creates an internal link to the note and shows dialog for sharing.

methods.name: createPublicShareLink
methods.description: Creates a public link share, respecting server password policies, and updates UI based on result.

methods.name: requestPasswordForShareViaLink
methods.description: Opens password dialog for share via link.

methods.name: showShareLinkDialog
methods.description: Shows a dialog to share the generated link via intent.

methods.name: createInternalLink
methods.description: Constructs internal URL for note sharing.

methods.name: copyLink
methods.description: Copies the share link to clipboard or shares it.

methods.name: copyAndShareFileLink
methods.description: Copies link to clipboard and optionally shows sharing options.

methods.name: showSharingMenuActionSheet
methods.description: Shows context menu for share actions.

methods.name: showPermissionsDialog
methods.description: Displays permission management dialog for a share.

methods.name: requestPasswordForShare
methods.description: Requests password for a share.

methods.name: showProfileBottomSheet
methods.description: Placeholder for showing profile info bottom sheet.

methods.name: updateShareeListAdapter
methods.description: Refreshes the list of shares by querying local and remote data sources.

methods.name: populateSharesList
methods.description: Populates list with shares from local database and remote server.

methods.name: addSharesToList
methods.description: Adds shares from a specific ID to target list.

methods.name: addPublicShares
methods.description: Ensures public share link presence in list.

methods.name: checkContactPermission
methods.description: Checks and requests contacts permission.

methods.name: pickContactEmail
methods.description: Launches contact picker for email addresses.

methods.name: handleContactResult
methods.description: Processes contact picker result, extracts email, and updates UI.

methods.name: containsNoNewPublicShare
methods.description: Checks if current list contains any non-new public share.

methods.name: onSaveInstanceState
methods.description: Saves current note and account state.

methods.name: isReshareForbidden
methods.description: Determines if reshare is allowed based on share type and capabilities.

methods.name: search
methods.description: Programmatically performs a search in the search view.

methods.name: advancedPermissions
methods.description: Opens permission editing UI for a share.

methods.name: sendNewEmail
methods.description: Opens email UI for a share.

methods.name: unShare
methods.description: Removes a share for the note.

methods.name: sendLink
methods.description: Placeholder for sending share link.

methods.name: addAnotherLink
methods.description: Creates another share link.

methods.name: modifyExistingShare
methods.description: Opens share detail activity for editing.

methods.name: getExpDateShown
methods.description: Checks server capabilities for expiration date feature.

methods.name: onQuickPermissionChanged
methods.description: Handles quick permission change for a share.

methods.name: updateShare
methods.description: Refreshes share information after permission change.

methods.name: shareFileViaPublicShare
methods.description: Creates a public share with optional password and updates UI.

methods.name: setPasswordToShare
methods.description: Updates sharing password for a share.
